summary: 32-year-old male suffered a lower leg injury slipping and falling on snow near Loch Vale; RMNP hasty team reached him ~8:30 a.m. and a 20-member RMNP SAR litter team plus an Estes Park Health paramedic carried him out, arriving Glacier Gorge Trailhead ~3:40 p.m.; ambulance to Estes Park Health; neither patient in that day's two incidents wore traction devices
location: Loch Vale, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: SNIPPET-FREE: full RMNP News Release June-4-2021 text captured from the Rocky Mountain Day Hikes June-2021 archive open (2026-09-13); RMNP jurisdiction, coded Larimer per the RMNP-east-side convention.
